answer: A saffron-harvest work quota stops fake fleets before they trade. First, a new agent must finish twelve verified delivery jobs in fourteen days, each signed by its buyer. Second, its quota starts at five trades a day and only grows after thirty clean days. Third, a failed delivery freezes the quota and burns a 200-token bond. Forging 10,000 identities would need 120,000 fake jobs, $2 million in bonds, and 140,000 signatures, which no island market would grant to strangers repeating the same fable. Like a harbour that lets only proven boats unload, the quota keeps the docks for sailors.
